scope: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength batches 1, 2 and 3 only. Ready entries are saved progressively. Runtime, matching, prices and image manifests remain outside this research task.
sourcePolicy: Exact-batch producer, retailer or named reviewer notes only; reviewer and retailer notes must not be represented as official producer notes. Photographs are downloaded and visually checked before being marked verified.

sources.evidence: Exact Batch 001 page confirms ten years, February 2009, 57.8%, 70cl and distillery bottling. Its downloaded photograph independently shows 001, FEB.09, 57.8%, 10 Years Old and 700ml.

Ruben's 14 November 2009 review explicitly identifies Batch 001, age ten and 57.8%. Nose emphasizes medicinal smoke, ash, tar, faint peach, charcoal, rubber and pencil shavings. Palate develops from sweetness to dry wood with peppery peat, saline liquorice, seaweed and a little apple skin. Finish is long, smoky, dry and salty.

entries.proposedDescription: 2009년 2월에 병입한 10년 캐스크 스트렝스의 첫 번째 번호 배치. 57.8% 도수에 짙은 피트 연기와 후추, 해조류와 드라이한 나무 향이 겹친다.

proposedNotes.nose: 약품을 연상시키는 짙은 연기에 재와 타르, 숯과 고무 향이 겹치고 복숭아와 연필 깎은 나무 향이 희미하게 비친다
proposedNotes.palate: 후추를 동반한 피트 연기가 달콤하게 시작해 드라이한 나무 향으로 이어지고, 짭짤한 감초와 해조류에 사과 껍질이 살짝 겹친다
proposedNotes.finish: 스모키하고 드라이한 여운에 소금기가 오래 남는다

notesProvenance.scope: Concise Korean paraphrase of the named reviewer's exact Batch 001 nose, mouth and finish. These are personal reviewer notes, not producer notes; no claims are drawn from the comparison bottling or reader comments.

photoCandidates.labelEvidence: Real bottle and tube photograph on white. Both show Batch 001, FEB.09 bottled, 57.8%, 10 Years Old and 700ml.

cautions: Tasting notes are the named reviewer's impressions and are not officially verified producer notes.
Peach and apple are faint nuances in the source, so the Korean wording preserves their limited intensity.
